item.title: Work templates for clear reports and better reviews
item.description: Download free editable work templates from FlowSight and Manuel Castillejo: weekly reports, focus trials, meeting audits, client handoffs and privacy reviews.

item.title: Weekly work report template
item.description: Download an editable weekly-report Markdown template for outcomes, evidence, blockers and next steps. Use it with FlowSight context or ordinary project notes.

item.title: Async team update template
item.description: Download a concise async-update Markdown template with outcomes, decisions and next actions. Use FlowSight summaries as material for a human-reviewed update.

item.title: Focus experiment worksheet
item.description: Download a CSV worksheet for a seven-day focus trial: task, observed condition, interpretation, adjustment and review. Useful with or without FlowSight.

item.title: Meeting audit worksheet
item.description: Download a CSV meeting-audit worksheet to review purpose, placement, preparation, decisions and trial changes alongside FlowSight work context.

item.title: Client handoff template
item.description: Download an editable client-handoff Markdown template for delivery state, authorized access, pending validation and next decisions. Useful with FlowSight summaries.

item.title: Work-data privacy review worksheet
item.description: Download a Markdown data-flow worksheet for local analysis, optional services, recipients and report sharing before a FlowSight trial or team pilot.
